strategy_note: Rank-chaser / elite 3-4-3 pattern: safe-haven core (Haaland 73.5% TSB, Raya 42.0% TSB, Saka) plus 1-2 calculated differentials. Captain = season cum_pts leader among nailed outfield premiums (APEX locked rule). Built blind from data/cache/player_pool.json + data/cache/xpts.json; carries on from the rival's own GW5 squad, with no access to the user's team.

Calvert-Lewin has an FDR 5 fixture (3.54 xPts). Brobbey: FDR 2, 2.94 xG and 3 goals in 399 mins, 6.2% TSB. Frees 0.3m.

transfer_note: 2 free transfers used (1 banked from GW5 + 1 GW6), 0 hit. A third move (Gakpo -> Ødegaard) gains only about +1.96 XI xPts, so it does not justify a -4 hit.
chip_note: No chip. Every squad player has a GW6 fixture (no BGW), there is no confirmed DGW, and no XI starter is rotation-flagged, so the APEX chip-timing gate says save. Maitland-Niles (177 mins in 5 GWs) fails the rotation gate and is benched.

budget.note: Valued at current pool prices. Exact ITB depends on FPL selling prices (only half of any price rise is kept).
budget.cap_check: max 3 per club satisfied (EVE 3: Tarkowski/Mykolenko/Maitland-Niles; ARS 2; MCI 2; rest 1)

key_differential: Brobbey (SUN, 6.2% TSB, 5.97 xPts, FDR 2): 2.94 xG, the best underlying shot volume in the sub-6m forward pool. Secondary: Emersonn (IPS, 3.4% TSB, 5.00 xPts, FDR 2).
risks: Captain Haaland has FDR 4 (8.15 xPts), and Saka (10.19) and Groß (11.83) project higher. The armband follows the locked APEX cum_pts rule and blocks a 73.5%-owned field, so there is zero captain edge.
The 3-4-3 shape benches Maitland-Niles (9.54 xPts), but he is rotation-flagged (avg about 35 mins).
3 EVE defenders stack clean-sheet correlation on one FDR 2 fixture.

projected_xpts uses the Sim Lab xpts.json priors, which look inflated for defenders and GKs this week (e.g. Tarkowski 12.76). Compare it with other engines on the same scale, not as an absolute points forecast.
